title: Normalize three date formats to ISO-8601
contract: Accepts yyyy-MM-dd, MM/dd/yyyy and dd-MMM-yyyy (English month, case-insensitive), ignores surrounding whitespace, and returns yyyy-MM-dd. Null, blank, unrecognized, and syntactically valid but non-existent dates all throw IllegalArgumentException; non-existent dates must not roll over.
notShownInJavadoc: upper and lower case month names
